RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.
NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
PARTY_VAT_TAKEN: An active party already has this VAT number.
ITEM_CODE_TAKEN: This code is already used by another item, archived ones included.
EDIT_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record in the meantime.
ARCHIVED: The record is archived: restore it to change it.
MODULE_NOT_ENABLED: This feature is not enabled for this customer.

DOCUMENT_HAS_ORIGIN: An order recorded this document: undo it from the order.
WAREHOUSE_NOT_EMPTY: The warehouse holds goods: it can be archived only when empty.
WAREHOUSE_CODE_TAKEN: Code already used by another warehouse of this company.
ALREADY_REVERSED: The document has already been reversed.
CANNOT_REVERSE_REVERSAL: A reversal cannot be reversed: record a new document.
DOCUMENT_ID_REUSED: The document changed after it was first sent: reload the page and start again.
